trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: While in sunlight, the shadow has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests}.

action.name: Draining Swipe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score decreases by {@dice 1d4}. The target dies if this reduces that score to 0. If a Humanoid is slain by this attack, a Shadow rises from the corpse {@dice 1d4} hours later.

bonus.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, the shadow takes the {@action Hide|XPHB} action.
